title: Code-Required Pans in Attached Dwellings for Self-Installed Units (Homeowner Service Contracts)
content:
On a company-elected offer worked out under the rule for replacements no network contractor can install, and only on such an offer, the cash carries the code-compliance addition for work the homeowner's own installer must now do, and no supplemental allowance is booked; every other cash settlement and every out-of-network reimbursement remains under the general allowance rule. This applies to Bridgewell Homeowner Service Contracts.

The code-compliance addition pays for the pan and discharge line that code requires when the self-installed unit sits in an attached dwelling:

| Item | Property type recorded on the contract | Code-compliance addition |
|---|---|---|
| water heater | townhome or condominium | 85.00 |
| heating system or cooling system | townhome or condominium | 80.00 |
| water heater, heating system or cooling system | single-family home or mobile home | nothing |
| any other item | any | nothing |

It is added to the company-elected cash basis as a flat dollar amount, never compounded, and the basis so obtained is compared with the remaining item and aggregate benefits without being rounded first.
